name: User can open the off-plan page and filter the result with "Out of Stock" option.
fullName: Off-plan Menu on Reelly: User can open the off-plan page and filter the result with "Out of Stock" option.

steps.name: Given Log in to the page
Then Verify the right page opens
When Click on the 'Search & filters' button
And Filter it to 'Out of Stock'
Then Verify that the results show the 'Out of Stock' tag in the result
